glosses.bottom: NOUN (thing). ⊥ — the diagonal fixed point; the framework's one dominant object. Faces span every domain.
glosses.ceiling: NOUN (thing). ε₀ — the ordinal the snap lands at; the endpoint the bottom rises to.
glosses.snap: VERB (act). the ⊥ → ε₀ transition itself (T-SNAP, DA-1, dichotomy). DISTINCT from `bottom` — noun vs verb; folding = category error.

glosses.algebra: algebraic structures beyond the core lattice — wheels, meadows (totalized division), rings/fields. ZPJ_Wheel/WheelFrac. Umbrella bucket for algebra edge cases, kept intentionally broad.
glosses.category: category theory — functors, initial/terminal objects, ZPCategory. ZP-G, ZP-H.
glosses.computability: computation, recursion, self-application, the Kleene fixed point. ZP-K, ZP-J self-app.
glosses.information: information theory — surprisal, entropy, no-external-description. ZP-C.
glosses.logic: propositional / predicate logic — the pure negation / diagonal engine (¬(p↔¬p)), the fixed-point-free root of the diagonal family. USE SPARINGLY, LAST-RESORT: only when no more specific domain fits — prefer computability (deciders / Bool / Turing), set-theory (Cantor / Russell / Foundation), or category (Lawvere) whenever the decl actually sits there. A peer sparse bucket, NOT a super-category. Currently exactly one member: ZPP_Wall.negation_no_fixedpoint (pure-Prop engine, homeless in every other bucket).
glosses.order: lattice / order algebra — join-semilattice, ⊔, ≼, bottom axiom A4, T-SNAP setting. ZP-A, ZP-E.
glosses.ordinal: ordinals, CNF, ε₀, Gentzen, independence. ZP-L, ZP-M, ZP-N, ZP-P (Goodstein/KirbyParis/Kruskal).
glosses.reals: the real numbers — counterexample layer where the snap fails (density). ZP-F.
glosses.set-theory: non-well-founded set theory — AFA, Quine atom, APG, Aczel, coalgebra. ZP-J, ZP-P, ZP-I.
glosses.state: the state / Hilbert-space layer — orthogonality, state space. ZP-D.
glosses.valuation: p-adic valuation, absolute values, Ostrowski, Bruhat-Tits tree. ZP-B, ZP-P (Ostrowski).

glosses.bridge: a transform connecting two domains (ZPH functors). An EDGE, not a cell.
glosses.no-go: an apophatic / obstruction result — establishes what ⊥ is NOT (no morphism, not-initial, counterexample, negation has no fixed point). The framework's fence made first-class. ~87 candidates in the corpus (padic_bottom_not_initial, negation_no_fixedpoint, the *_NoGo/*_Obstruction files, the reals counterexample, the wall ZPP_Wall). NOTE: role is ALSO a hardcoded sjv schema enum, so this needs the sjv-side role enum updated (see interop).
glosses.commitment: a labeled modeling commitment / identity claim (MC-1). Held, not proved.
glosses.core: a central load-bearing result (T-SNAP, the Quine-atom keystone).
glosses.face: a (object, domain) cell — an object realized inside one domain.
glosses.go: a confirmed-POSITIVE gauge result — a probe/construction that SUCCEEDS (the GO verdict), the positive complement of `no-go`. Marks the experimental campaign's confirmed positives (a connection/convergence/construction that works). Distinct from `face`: `go` is a gauge VERDICT on a probe (did it work?), `face` is a structural ⊥-realization in a domain. From the no-go-gauge campaign — GO and NO-GO are the matched verdict pair. Like no-go, apply SPARINGLY (headline probe verdicts, not every positive lemma).
glosses.infra: non-framework build scaffolding (Basic, AxiomProfile). Vendored EXCLUDED, not tagged.
glosses.scaffolding: a helper/stepping-stone decl, not a headline claim.
glosses.schema: structure ABOUT the matrix — the synthesis/meta layer (ZP-P fork, the diagonal-fixed-point keystone).
